messages:
Maya (Design): shared a compact mock for the autoscale & capacity panel: min/max inputs, SLO slider, burst toggle, GPU pool selector. figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz
Alex (Product): looks good. suggestion: make SLO less scary for new users 100 ms balanced preset + helper copy.
Samir (Eng): FYI pools are g4, l4, a100. dropdown should show estimated qps and $/hr per pool; backend can provide those numbers.
Maya (Design): planned row layout: pool name on one line, small text under: "~600 qps 3 $2.80/hr" to keep it compact.
Leah (Accessibility): a11y pass: 1) slider must support arrow keys (1% increments) and PageUp/PageDown (10%). 2) secondary text contrast needs to reach 4.5:1. 3) GPU dropdown requires typeahead and aria-activedescendant.
Samir (Eng): add guardrail: if SLO <60 ms and pool==l4, show inline notice: "Estimated p95 with this pool: ~120 ms." we'll compute estimate server-side.
Maya (Design): draft microcopy for guardrail: "Note: estimated p95 with selected pool is ~120 ms. Consider a higher-performance pool or enabling burst."
Leah (Accessibility): prefer neutral phrasing and mark the note with role="status" so screen readers announce it.
Jon (SRE): burst tooltip text: "Temporary burst capacity uses spare GPU slots for short spikes; billed while active. Default cap = 2x reserved." also ops wants telemetry: capacity.burst.triggered {team_id, pool, duration_s}.
Samir (Eng): will emit that event after successful allocation. backend will also expose /orgs/{id}/autoscale/suggest returning recommended_min, recommended_max, reason.
Maya (Design): UI will show "Recommended: min 2 3 max 8" with a one-click Apply. default fallbacks min=1 max=16.
Alex (Product): require confirmation when new min > current instances: buttons "Apply and migrate (may restart)" vs "Apply without migration".
Leah (Accessibility): modal must trap focus and include descriptive aria-labels. ensure all form controls have programmatic labels.
Maya (Design): i'll update figma with contrast fixes, ARIA notes, revised microcopy, burst tooltip, and recommended-range UI. ops-bot: please upload the updated file when ready.
ops-bot: uploaded updated figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz?node-id=99 :thumbsup:
Alex (Product): draft acceptance criteria: 1) accessible SLO slider + labeled presets; 2) GPU pool list shows qps & $/hr and supports typeahead; 3) burst toggle with tooltip and billing note; 4) guardrail appears with role=status when triggered; 5) recommended min/max shown with one-click apply.
Samir (Eng): implementation ETA 2 sprints. will coordinate API work.
Maya (Design): thanks all  i'll post the updated mock tomorrow. :sparkles:
